Subject: Performance review — synchronize availability for results + live demo

Hi Samir / ACME eng team,

Thanks again for running the initial throughput tests last week — the preliminary numbers look promising. We'd like to schedule a 60–75 minute session to:
- walk through the test methodology and key KPIs,
- present the summary results, and
- run a short live demo of the production workload (end-to-end request pattern + tail-latency view).

Attendees we'd like to include: your Eng Manager (Samir), one ACME SRE or engineer who ran the tests, your procurement contact (copying Lina if needed), and from our side: Ben (AE), Diego (SE lead), Evelyn (Solutions Manager).

Could you please share 3 windows in the next two weeks that work for the core engineering group? Ideally US mornings (9–11am PT) or early afternoons (1–3pm PT) so Diego can join live. If none of those fit, we can do an evening slot.

Before the session, Diego will share a short checklist and a tiny artifact bundle that helps us reproduce the client-side harness. If you have an internal test matrix (CSV) you can drop into the Drive link below that would speed calibration.

Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB_example-drive-link
HubSpot deal: ACME-REDW-2026-Q3

Thanks — looking forward to finalizing a slot.

—
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.inference
+1 (650) 555-0114

Thanks, Priya — happy to align.

Quick availability from the engineering team:
- Tue Jul 6: 9:30–11:00am PT
- Wed Jul 7: 1:00–2:30pm PT
- Thu Jul 8: 10:00–11:00am PT (shorter window)

Our SRE who ran the harness (Lina) will attend. A couple of asks from our side before the call:
1) Can you drop the exact command sequence or container image you’ll run during the live demo? We want to validate host setup in advance.
2) Please confirm whether any service account or outbound IP allowlist is required.
3) Procurement (cc'd) will want a rough estimate of session duration for internal calendar/approval routing.

I attached a quick test matrix we used (ACME_proposed_test_matrix.csv) — it lists payload sizes and concurrency.

Hi Samir / Lina —

Thanks for the test matrix — that's perfect. To make the live demo frictionless, please find a short checklist and two tiny artifacts attached below. If the team can confirm the checklist items before the session, we can avoid an onsite debug.

Checklist (quick):
- Provide a single VM/container with outbound HTTPS to redwood inference endpoints (no special ports).
- If you need allowlisting: we will provide IPs 18.205.XX.XX and 34.201.XX.XX (staging/demo endpoints).
- Share the CSV you attached in the Drive folder (ACME_proposed_test_matrix.csv) — done.
- Confirm preferred demo TTL (we recommend 30–45 minutes demo + 20–30 minutes Q&A).

Attached (stubs):
- redwood-kpi-checklist.xlsx (xlsx) — quick validation sheet we’ll follow live
- redwood-demo-boot-commands.sh (text) — lightweight command list to bootstrap the client harness

If you want, I can run a 15-minute pre-check session the day before to validate connectivity.

Quick procurement note so we can clear the internal calendar:
- Please confirm the expected session duration (we budget 90 minutes for this, please advise if shorter).
- We need SOC 2 Type II attestation and a point of contact for security questions. Can you provide the SOC 2 report link or a recent letter?
